thm circle_chord_side_dot_coordinate:
    ? forall dx, dy, tx, ty, cx, cy R:
        2 * (cx * dx + cy * dy) = dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2
        2 * (cx * tx + cy * ty) = tx ^ 2 + ty ^ 2
        =>:
            ((tx ^ 2 + ty ^ 2) - (dx * tx + dy * ty)) * (dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2) = 2 * (dx * cy - dy * cx) * (dx * ty - dy * tx)
    2 * (dx * cy - dy * cx) * (dx * ty - dy * tx) = 2 * ((dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2) * (cx * tx + cy * ty) - (cx * dx + cy * dy) * (dx * tx + dy * ty)) = (dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2) * 2 * (cx * tx + cy * ty) - 2 * (cx * dx + cy * dy) * (dx * tx + dy * ty) = (dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2) * (tx ^ 2 + ty ^ 2) - (dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2) * (dx * tx + dy * ty) = ((tx ^ 2 + ty ^ 2) - (dx * tx + dy * ty)) * (dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2)

thm circle_chord_side_dot_metric:
    ? forall o, a, b, p cart(R, R), radius R+:
        $m0::f0::is_on_circle(a, o, radius)
        $m0::f0::is_on_circle(b, o, radius)
        $m0::f0::is_on_circle(p, o, radius)
        =>:
            m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(p, a), m0::f0::vec(p, b)) * m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b) = 2 * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p))
    by def $m0::f0::is_on_circle(a, o, radius)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(o, a) = radius * radius = radius ^ 2
    by def $m0::f0::is_on_circle(b, o, radius)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(o, b) = radius * radius = radius ^ 2
    by def $m0::f0::is_on_circle(p, o, radius)
    m0::f0::distance_sq(o, p) = radius * radius = radius ^ 2
    have dx R = b(1) - a(1)
    have dy R = b(2) - a(2)
    have tx R = p(1) - a(1)
    have ty R = p(2) - a(2)
    have cx R = o(1) - a(1)
    have cy R = o(2) - a(2)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, b)
    dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2 = (b(1) - a(1)) ^ 2 + (b(2) - a(2)) ^ 2 = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)
    release thm m0::f0::twice_dot_from_distances_direct(o, a, b)
    release thm m0::f0::perpendicular_dot_expand(a, o, a, b)
    (m0::f0::distance_sq(o, a) + m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)) - m0::f0::distance_sq(o, b) = (radius ^ 2 + m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)) - radius ^ 2 = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)
    2 * (cx * dx + cy * dy) = 2 * ((o(1) - a(1)) * (b(1) - a(1)) + (o(2) - a(2)) * (b(2) - a(2))) = 2 * m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(a, o), m0::f0::vec(a, b)) = 2 * ((m0::f0::distance_sq(o, a) + m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)) - m0::f0::distance_sq(o, b)) / 2 = (radius ^ 2 + m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)) - radius ^ 2 = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b) = dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, p)
    tx ^ 2 + ty ^ 2 = (p(1) - a(1)) ^ 2 + (p(2) - a(2)) ^ 2 = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, p)
    release thm m0::f0::twice_dot_from_distances_direct(o, a, p)
    release thm m0::f0::perpendicular_dot_expand(a, o, a, p)
    (m0::f0::distance_sq(o, a) + m0::f0::distance_sq(a, p)) - m0::f0::distance_sq(o, p) = (radius ^ 2 + m0::f0::distance_sq(a, p)) - radius ^ 2 = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, p)
    2 * (cx * tx + cy * ty) = 2 * ((o(1) - a(1)) * (p(1) - a(1)) + (o(2) - a(2)) * (p(2) - a(2))) = 2 * m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(a, o), m0::f0::vec(a, p)) = 2 * ((m0::f0::distance_sq(o, a) + m0::f0::distance_sq(a, p)) - m0::f0::distance_sq(o, p)) / 2 = (radius ^ 2 + m0::f0::distance_sq(a, p)) - radius ^ 2 = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, p) = tx ^ 2 + ty ^ 2
    release thm circle_chord_side_dot_coordinate(dx, dy, tx, ty, cx, cy)
    release thm m0::f0::perpendicular_dot_expand(p, a, p, b)
    m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(p, a), m0::f0::vec(p, b)) = (a(1) - p(1)) * (b(1) - p(1)) + (a(2) - p(2)) * (b(2) - p(2)) = -(p(1) - a(1)) * ((b(1) - a(1)) - (p(1) - a(1))) + -(p(2) - a(2)) * ((b(2) - a(2)) - (p(2) - a(2))) = -tx * (dx - tx) + -ty * (dy - ty) = (tx ^ 2 + ty ^ 2) - (dx * tx + dy * ty)
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, o)
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) = (b(1) - a(1)) * (o(2) - a(2)) - (b(2) - a(2)) * (o(1) - a(1)) = dx * cy - dy * cx
    release thm m0::f0::collinear_det_expand(a, b, p)
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p)) = (b(1) - a(1)) * (p(2) - a(2)) - (b(2) - a(2)) * (p(1) - a(1)) = dx * ty - dy * tx
    m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(p, a), m0::f0::vec(p, b)) * m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b) = ((tx ^ 2 + ty ^ 2) - (dx * tx + dy * ty)) * (dx ^ 2 + dy ^ 2) = 2 * (dx * cy - dy * cx) * (dx * ty - dy * tx) = 2 * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p))
stores:
forall o, a, b, p cart(R, R), radius R+:
    $m0::f0::is_on_circle(a, o, radius)
    $m0::f0::is_on_circle(b, o, radius)
    $m0::f0::is_on_circle(p, o, radius)
    =>:
        m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(p, a), m0::f0::vec(p, b)) * m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b) = 2 * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p))

prop is_angle_in_circular_segment(o, a, b, p cart(R, R), radius R+, side, alpha R):
    a != b
    a != p
    b != p
    a != o
    b != o
    $m0::f0::is_on_circle(a, o, radius)
    $m0::f0::is_on_circle(b, o, radius)
    $m0::f0::is_on_circle(p, o, radius)
    side = 1 or side = -1
    side * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p)) > 0
    alpha = f1::ray_angle(a, p, b)

thm proposition_31_semicircle:
    ? forall o, a, b, p cart(R, R), radius R+, side, alpha R:
        $f2::is_angle_in_circular_segment(o, a, b, p, radius, side, alpha)
        m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) = 0
        =>:
            $m0::f0::is_right_angle(a, p, b)
            alpha = pi / 2
    by def $f2::is_angle_in_circular_segment(o, a, b, p, radius, side, alpha)
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(a, b)
    release thm circle_chord_side_dot_metric(o, a, b, p, radius)
    have length_sq R+ = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)
    have dot_value R = m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(p, a), m0::f0::vec(p, b))
    dot_value * length_sq = 2 * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p)) = 2 * 0 * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p)) = 0
    dot_value = dot_value * length_sq / length_sq = 0 / length_sq = 0
    m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(p, a), m0::f0::vec(p, b)) = dot_value = 0
    by def $m0::f0::is_right_angle(a, p, b)
    release thm f1::right_angle_has_measure_half_pi(a, p, b)
    alpha = f1::ray_angle(a, p, b) = pi / 2
stores:
forall o, a, b, p cart(R, R), radius R+, side, alpha R:
    $f2::is_angle_in_circular_segment(o, a, b, p, radius, side, alpha)
    m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) = 0
    =>:
        $m0::f0::is_right_angle(a, p, b)
        alpha = pi / 2

thm proposition_31_greater_segment:
    ? forall o, a, b, p cart(R, R), radius R+, side, alpha R:
        $f2::is_angle_in_circular_segment(o, a, b, p, radius, side, alpha)
        side * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) > 0
        =>:
            alpha < pi / 2
    by def $f2::is_angle_in_circular_segment(o, a, b, p, radius, side, alpha)
    by cases:
        ? side ^ 2 = 1
        case side = 1:
            side ^ 2 = 1 ^ 2 = 1
        case side = -1:
            side ^ 2 = -1 ^ 2 = 1
    have center_det R = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o))
    have vertex_det R = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p))
    side * center_det = side * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) > 0
    side * vertex_det = side * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p)) > 0
    center_det * vertex_det = 1 * center_det * vertex_det = side ^ 2 * center_det * vertex_det = side * center_det * side * vertex_det > 0
    release thm m0::f0::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(a, b)
    release thm circle_chord_side_dot_metric(o, a, b, p, radius)
    have length_sq R+ = m0::f0::distance_sq(a, b)
    have dot_value R = m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(p, a), m0::f0::vec(p, b))
    center_det * vertex_det = m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p))
    dot_value * length_sq = 2 * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p)) = 2 * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p)) = 2 * center_det * vertex_det > 0
    dot_value = dot_value * length_sq / length_sq > 0 / length_sq = 0
    release thm f0::angle_den_positive(a, p, b)
    have root_den R+ = sqrt (m0::f0::angle_cos_den(a, p, b))
    m0::f0::angle_cos_num(a, p, b) = m0::f0::dot(m0::f0::vec(p, a), m0::f0::vec(p, b)) = dot_value
    f0::angle_cosine(a, p, b) = m0::f0::angle_cos_num(a, p, b) / sqrt (m0::f0::angle_cos_den(a, p, b)) = dot_value / root_den > 0 / root_den = 0
    release thm f1::angle_cosine_bounded(a, p, b)
    release thm f1::arccos_strictly_decreasing(0, f0::angle_cosine(a, p, b))
    alpha = f1::ray_angle(a, p, b) = arccos(f0::angle_cosine(a, p, b)) < arccos(0) = pi / 2

    $f2::is_angle_in_circular_segment(o, a, b, p, radius, side, alpha)
    side * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) > 0
    =>:

    ? forall o, a, b, p cart(R, R), radius R+, side, alpha R:

    dot_value * length_sq = 2 * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p)) = 2 * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, o)) * m0::f0::det(m0::f0::vec(a, b), m0::f0::vec(a, p)) = 2 * center_det * vertex_det < 0

    release thm f1::angle_cosine_bounded(a, p, b)
    release thm f1::arccos_strictly_decreasing(f0::angle_cosine(a, p, b), 0)
    alpha = f1::ray_angle(a, p, b) = arccos(f0::angle_cosine(a, p, b)) > arccos(0) = pi / 2
